function.name: create_sap_object
function.description: Create a NEW SAP object (class or program) that the user explicitly asked to create and save in the system. The result is wrapped in a <code_created> envelope. Do NOT use when the user only wants a code example - use show_code_example instead.

object_type.description: Type of SAP object to create

object_name.description: Technical name for the new object, e.g. 'ZCL_NEW_CLASS', 'Z_NEW_PROG'

requirements.description: What the new object must do
